question: According to Chart TF-G, around what year did the US Highway Trust Fund have outlays exceeding receipts between the fiscal years 1987-1991?
raw_response:
I can see the chart clearly now. The solid line (Receipts) peaks around 1989 (~17), then drops sharply toward 1990 (~15.1), while the dashed line (Outlays) rises steadily to ~15.3 at 1990. At 1990, the dashed Outlays line crosses above the solid Receipts line — the Outlays dashed line is slightly higher than the Receipts solid line at the 1990 point. After 1990, Receipts rise sharply again above Outlays.

So Outlays exceeded Receipts around 1990.

<FINAL_ANSWER>1990</FINAL_ANSWER>
